art_instructions: Set the scene outside the small Greek village school in bright sun: whitewashed walls with blue wooden trim, terracotta roof, and a wooden-porch entry; an olive tree and bougainvillea frame the background, with a stone path leading to the door. In the lower right foreground, place a rounded knee‑high stone on the path; two clearly visible small gray‑brown mice stand on top (one on hind legs sniffing, the other crouched), both with thin tails and whiskers. Center-left midground stands Dinosaur, child-sized, pea‑green with a pale mint belly and small triangular dorsal nubs, wearing his small red backpack; he leans back slightly, eyes wide, mouth open, and points at the mice with a stubby finger in alarm. Add a clear speech bubble from Dinosaur at mouth height that reads: «ἰδού, εἰσὶ δύο μύες ἐπὶ τῷ λίθῳ!». Just behind and a little to the left of Dinosaur, place Panda, round-faced with black ear tufts and dark eye patches; Panda half-hides behind Dinosaur, one paw up near the mouth or gripping Dinosaur’s backpack strap, one foot lifted as if stepping back, eyes wide with a small “o” mouth to show fear. Keep both characters at consistent child scale, their shadows falling across the stone path in the bright sunlight. In the background, include a window with blue shutters and the porch columns to establish the school, plus soft olive-branch shadows; no other characters are visible. Frame the composition so the mice on the stone, Dinosaur’s pointing gesture, and Panda’s fearful stance are all clearly readable for young viewers.
